rawConfiguration.text:
## Linkerd (OpenTelemetry Collector)

Linkerd is a lightweight, security-focused service mesh for Kubernetes that provides mTLS, observability, and traffic management for microservices without code changes.

**Useful Links**
- [Installation guide](https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/opentelemetry/integrations/linkerd/linkerd-otel-overview/)
- [Linkerd documentation](https://linkerd.io/docs/)
- [OTel Collector config](https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/opentelemetry/integrations/linkerd/linkerd-otel-overview/#collector-config)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT rate(sum(inbound_http_requests_total), 1 minute) FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' FACET k8s.deployment.name TIMESERIES
SELECT rate(sum(outbound_http_route_request_statuses_total), 1 minute) FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' FACET parent_name, parent_namespace TIMESERIES

SELECT 100.0 * filter(sum(inbound_http_statuses_total), WHERE status NOT LIKE '5%') / sum(inbound_http_statuses_total) AS 'Success %' FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' AND linkerd_control_plane_component IS NULL FACET k8s.deployment.name TIMESERIES

SELECT 100.0 * filter(sum(inbound_http_statuses_total), WHERE status LIKE '5%') / sum(inbound_http_statuses_total) AS 'Error %' FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' AND linkerd_control_plane_component IS NULL FACET k8s.deployment.name TIMESERIES

SELECT percentile(inbound_http_request_duration_seconds, 50) * 1000 AS 'p50 ms', percentile(inbound_http_request_duration_seconds, 95) * 1000 AS 'p95 ms', percentile(inbound_http_request_duration_seconds, 99) * 1000 AS 'p99 ms' FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' FACET k8s.deployment.name TIMESERIES
SELECT percentile(inbound_http_request_duration_seconds, 99) * 1000 AS 'p99 ms' FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' FACET k8s.deployment.name LIMIT 10
SELECT percentile(outbound_http_route_request_duration_seconds, 99) FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' FACET parent_name TIMESERIES
SELECT rate(sum(inbound_http_statuses_total), 1 minute) FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' FACET status TIMESERIES
SELECT rate(sum(tcp_read_bytes_total) + sum(tcp_write_bytes_total), 1 second) FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' FACET k8s.deployment.name TIMESERIES
SELECT sum(tcp_open_connections) FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' FACET k8s.deployment.name TIMESERIES
SELECT sum(inbound_http_authz_allow_total) FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' TIMESERIES

SELECT 100.0 * filter(sum(inbound_http_statuses_total), WHERE status NOT LIKE '5%') / sum(inbound_http_statuses_total) AS 'Success %' FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' AND linkerd_control_plane_component IS NULL

SELECT latest(control_destination_balancer_endpoints) AS 'destination', latest(control_identity_balancer_endpoints) AS 'identity', latest(control_policy_balancer_endpoints) AS 'policy' FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry'
SELECT min(control_identity_cert_expiration_timestamp_seconds) - (latest(timestamp) / 1000) AS 'Seconds until expiry' FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry'
SELECT rate(sum(control_identity_cert_refreshes_total), 1 minute) FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' TIMESERIES

SELECT rate(sum(control_request_total), 1 minute) AS 'Req/min' FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' AND linkerd_control_plane_ns IS NOT NULL FACET k8s.deployment.name TIMESERIES

SELECT latest(control_destination_balancer_queue_length) AS 'destination', latest(control_identity_balancer_queue_length) AS 'identity', latest(control_policy_balancer_queue_length) AS 'policy', latest(opentelemetry_balancer_queue_length) AS 'otel-exporter' FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' TIMESERIES

SELECT rate(sum(inbound_http_authz_allow_total), 1 minute) AS 'http allow', rate(sum(inbound_tcp_authz_allow_total), 1 minute) AS 'tcp allow' FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' FACET k8s.deployment.name TIMESERIES

SELECT rate(sum(process_cpu_seconds_total), 1 second) AS 'CPU (cores)' FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' AND linkerd_control_plane_ns IS NOT NULL FACET k8s.deployment.name TIMESERIES

SELECT latest(process_resident_memory_bytes) / 1e6 AS 'RSS (MB)', latest(process_virtual_memory_bytes) / 1e6 AS 'VSZ (MB)' FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' AND linkerd_control_plane_ns IS NOT NULL AND linkerd_control_plane_component IS NULL FACET k8s.deployment.name TIMESERIES

SELECT rate(sum(request_total), 1 minute) AS 'Req/min' FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' AND direction = 'outbound' AND linkerd_control_plane_component IS NULL AND linkerd_control_plane_ns IS NOT NULL AND dst_service IS NOT NULL FACET concat(k8s.deployment.name, ' → ', dst_service, ' (', dst_namespace, ')') AS 'Service Call' SINCE 30 minutes ago LIMIT 20

## Route-level Metrics

**Note:** Route-level request rate requires [HTTPRoute policies](https://linkerd.io/2/tasks/configuring-dynamic-request-routing/) to be applied to your services. If this chart shows no data, configure HTTPRoute resources for your workloads first.

To enable, refer to: [Linkerd OTel installation guide](https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/opentelemetry/integrations/linkerd/linkerd-otel-overview/#route-level-metrics)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT rate(sum(outbound_http_route_request_statuses_total), 1 minute) AS 'Req/min' FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' AND linkerd_control_plane_component IS NULL AND route_name IS NOT NULL FACET k8s.deployment.name AS 'Service', route_name AS 'Route' TIMESERIES LIMIT 10

SELECT uniqueCount(k8s.pod.name) AS 'Pods' FROM Metric WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'opentelemetry' AND metricName = 'up' FACET k8s.namespace.name AS 'Namespace', k8s.deployment.name AS 'Deployment' LIMIT 50
